scripts.ui:build: cd ui && bun install && bun run build
scripts.desktop:dev: bun run ui:build && cd apps/desktop && bunx @tauri-apps/cli@^2 dev
scripts.desktop:build: bun run ui:build && cd apps/desktop && bunx @tauri-apps/cli@^2 build --bundles app --target aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.desktop:icon: cd apps/desktop && bun install && bun run icon
scripts.desktop:release: bun run ui:build && cd apps/desktop && bunx @tauri-apps/cli@^2 build --bundles app,dmg --target universal-apple-darwin
